spec: §5.2: "tgt final = initial ⊕ payload(F_B(x)); fr final = initial ⊕ code(F_B(x))"; §4.2: "Every row is one budget step"; §15 C: "T3 over full D"
derivation: inc2 executes const,add,retval (3 steps). At B=3, F_B(0)=((0+1) mod 4,0)=(1,0). Initial target 2 XOR 1 = 3; initial fault 14 XOR 0 = 14; input 0 unchanged. This enumerates all 2+2+4=8 interface bits (256 tuples); there is no memory/borrowed state. The wrapper only exposes the oracle tuple, with no transformed arithmetic.
